description: Publishes a monitoring-only DMARC record (p=none) at _dmarc under the sending domain ([host.]domain). Aopy offers it only after reading, right before it builds the apply URL, that neither the sending domain nor its zone has a DMARC record; the template does not stop a second DMARC record on providers that ignore TXT conflict matching. On providers that track applied templates, OnApply lets the owner change or remove the record without dropping the template.
variableDescription: No variables: the report address uses the built-in %fqdn%.
